workflow.title: Phase II Environmental Site Assessment
workflow.description: Regulatory, technical, sampling, laboratory, and supporting resources commonly used to investigate recognized environmental conditions in Connecticut.

relationships.workflow_note: Open the authoritative ASTM product page for the professional practice standard associated with the Phase II Environmental Site Assessment process.
Use when developing the investigation approach and considering Connecticut guidance for characterizing soil, groundwater, vapor, and other affected media.
Consult when investigation activities concern a release subject to Connecticut's current reporting and characterization framework.
Use as a technical reference when low-flow groundwater sample collection is appropriate to the investigation.
Use to access Connecticut laboratory QA/QC expectations, Reasonable Confidence Protocols, forms, and method-specific supporting material.
Use when reviewing laboratory deliverables and evaluating whether analytical data are suitable for their intended investigative use.
Use to confirm current Connecticut laboratory certification information and access approved environmental laboratory lists.
